item.description:
0.1.19

The save upload actually works this time

0.1.18 announced that the Mac app uploads a copy of your save, and then shipped without the credential it needed to do it. The app was built before the credential was put in place, so it went out without one and quietly uploaded nothing.

Everything 0.1.18 said still holds, and now it's true. A compressed copy of your save goes to a private bucket only Colin can read, copies are kept rather than overwritten, and nothing else about the app changes.

0.1.18

Your save file now travels with your farm data

When the Mac app reads your save, it also uploads a compressed copy of that save file to a private bucket that only Colin can read. Nothing else changes: the app works exactly as it did.

This is worth saying plainly, because it's your whole game in there. Every relationship, every choice, every day.

The reason is that four separate bugs this month came down to the app reading one thing from your save and quietly getting a different one, and none of them could be diagnosed from a screenshot. The wrong crop counts were the visible one. Having the actual file is the difference between guessing at what the app saw and knowing.

Copies are kept rather than overwritten, because a problem noticed on Thursday is usually about Tuesday's save.

Mac only

Nothing changed in the iPhone app for this one, so there's no new build for it.

0.1.17

Quests have their names back

Every quest on the Tracking tab was called "Quest". Your save records the title twice, once in a cache that is usually empty and once beside it with the real answer, and the app was reading the empty one. It reads the answer now.

This was never about a particular version of the game. Saves going back years are shaped the same way, so anything you had open was affected.

Quests tell you what comes next

A gathering quest has two parts. Getting the wood is one. Handing it over is the other, and your save only ever records the part you're on, so "0/35 Wood collected" was the whole story the app could tell.

It now shows both steps, what's done, and who to go back to:

  • Gathering: Wood — 0/35 Wood collected, then Talk to Robin

Quests that finish the moment you're done get one step, because that's how many they have. A delivery quest already says "Bring Sebastian Bream" and nothing in the game counts the fishing, so it isn't given a stage it doesn't have.

Special orders say what they want

Ten of the town's special orders were listed with one objective when the game asks for two, and one of them showed "Ship 100" without saying of what. Every order's objectives now come from the game's own data, so they say what they want and how far along you are. Willy's three fish had also been paired with each other's counts.
